notes.title: Design a Lorebook Cover for Chronicles Reborn!
notes.content:
📜 Lorebook Design Competition


Calling all Brightwyn creators! :sparkles:We’re hosting a community art competition to design covers for the collectible Lorebooks in Chronicles Reborn. These books are brimming with stories, knowledge, and secrets. Now, we’re inviting you to design their covers and leave your mark on the game’s history.


How to Participate:
 Choose one of the five Lorebook title logos (images provided below) as the base for your cover design.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292399/d3aba870d2a22727dd11f19713c6d5c4e0630fb3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292399/38bc629ff9001b864c87f60e1efbdb948ef58830.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292399/e7abdf12ac86eb9091226e04324a5b239cd2b019.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292399/683947fa3eed46bb7268cba453bf7527cc03bf42.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292399/6284c40abada092e111a372061cb80867ca6fa83.png"]

 Create a cover that fits the fantasy style of Chronicles Reborn and incorporates your chosen title.

 No AI-generated images — all entries must be original artwork.

 Join our Discord server for the full list of rules, design guides, and to submit your cover in the #lorebook-competition forum.

                                                      Join Our Discord


Prize:
Your cover will be featured in-game as a collectible.

Your name will appear in the game credits to celebrate your contribution.

A Steam key for Chronicles Reborn at release!


Deadline:Submissions close 7th September 2025


💡 Let your creativity run wild — the sands of Brightwyn await your stories!
🔗 Join our Discord for full details: Chronicles Reborn Discord

notes.title: 🔥 A Closed Playtest is Coming Soon – Join the Discord for a Chance to Play!
notes.content:
⚔️ Chronicles Reborn – Closed Playtest Coming Soon! ⚔️
Big things are happening in Chronicles Reborn! The world is expanding, mechanics are being refined, and a Closed Playtest is on the horizon. This is your chance to play early and help shape the game’s future!

🔥 How to Join the Closed Playtest 🔥
A limited number of players will be selected to participate in this early test phase. Here’s how you can be considered:

✅ Join the official Chronicles Reborn Discord.
✅ Fill out the upcoming application form.
✅ Stay tuned for updates—only selected players will be invited!

👾 Join us on Discord!👾

⏳ When Will the Playtest Start?
The Playtest is coming soon—but the exact date will be revealed later. Make sure you’re in the Discord so you don’t miss any announcements!

In the meantime, don’t forget to wishlist Chronicles Reborn and spread the word. Your adventure is about to begin!

🛡️ See you in the world of Chronicles Reborn! 🏹

notes.title: 🎄 Dev Blog #1 – A Festive Update and Busy Progress 🎄
notes.content:
What’s Happening Behind the Scenes?

Hey everyone!

I hope you’re all doing well and enjoying the holiday season so far. It’s been a busy few weeks for me, and I wanted to take a moment to share what I’ve been working on behind the scenes. I know I promised a gameplay video and news about the demo, but with everything going on, it’s taking me a bit longer than planned. Let me tell you what’s been keeping me so occupied!

Polishing Systems and Gameplay

First off, I’ve been diving deep into the development of Chronicles Reborn—focusing on the playable demo, updating the UI, and refining a lot of core systems. A big part of this has been polishing resource gathering, improving mounts, and ensuring that the game mechanics feel smooth and satisfying. I’ve also been tweaking visual effects, especially for combat and environment interactions, to bring more life to the game world. These details might seem small, but they add up and make a big difference when it comes to creating an immersive experience.

Website and Steam Page Overhaul

In addition to development, I’ve been spending a lot of time updating my website and the Steam page. I’ve been working on optimizing how the game is presented to make it more visually appealing and easier to navigate. These updates include better visuals, clearer descriptions, and making sure everything aligns with the progress I’ve made so far. I want to ensure that when people discover Chronicles Reborn, they get a true sense of what the game is all about.

The Legal Stuff 📜
It’s not the most glamorous part of development, but I’ve also been working on legal aspects of the game—things like trademarks, licensing, and other protections to set the project up for success. It’s a lot to juggle, but it’s essential to ensure everything is in place as the game moves forward.

A Touch of Festive Spirit 🎅
December is always a busy month with the holidays around the corner. Between wrapping presents, family plans, and festive chaos, I couldn’t resist adding a little holiday magic to the game. Here’s a cozy sneak peek of the player decorating a Christmas tree—just a small way to bring the season into Chronicles Reborn!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292399/f68833e31fcc5df2fcf9c4a607e3bd1ed48e92f6.png

Looking Ahead 👀
I want to thank you all for being so patient and supportive. While progress has been slower this month, I’m still working hard every day to bring the game to life. I’m committed to sharing more updates and that much-awaited demo in the coming months.

Happy Holidays & Thank You!
I hope you all have an incredible holiday season filled with joy, warmth, and maybe even some gaming time. 🎮

Thank you for being part of this journey with me—I’ll be back soon with more news and updates!

Stay tuned and Happy Holidays! 🎄✨

Kay
